name: Enhance Physique, Mass
body:
Design alteration; Level 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This script functions as enhance physique, except that it affects multiple creatures. All creatures must have the same ability score enhanced.

Overload: For every two runic charges overloaded into this script, you can grant all targets an enhancement bonus to an additional ability score.
